component.name: Jap Studio
component.summary: DAW nativo acelerado por GPU para Linux

description.p: Jap Studio is a native Rust and GPUI digital audio workstation built for fast beatmaking, sound design, mixing, and collaborative music production on Linux.

ul.li: Low-latency PipeWire/ALSA audio engine with live input monitoring and multi-track recording
Drums Sequencer and 4x4 MPC Pads with 16 Levels, real-time Note Repeat, Overdub, and transient Sample Chop
Built-in native effects: Hay EQ, Hay Comp (with Sidechain), Hay Limiter, Hay Echo, Hay Reverb (with Freeze), and Convolver
Audio Clip Warp (Re-Pitch, Beats, Complex), Piano Roll, Sampler, and VST3 plugin hosting
Real-time P2P session collaboration over Loro CRDT + Iroh QUIC and built-in MCP server for AI assistants

description.p: First public Flatpak beta release featuring native PCM Drums Sampler, 4x4 MPC Pads with Chop-to-Pads, Clip Warp, Hay Dynamics/Echo/Reverb with Tempo Sync & Sidechain, P2P Collaboration, and MCP AI Server.
